title: Chirality-flip implications for existing MD-36..62 closures
verdict: All existing MD-36..62 closures (theta_13, Jarlskog, V_us, R_b, etc.) use the canonical N=50 anchor System-R values and match PDG/NuFIT data to 0.01-0.5%. The chirality-flip running discovered at iter-31..36 is a LATTICE-INTERNAL phenomenon: the bounded-operator lattice readouts run with finite N, but the canonical anchor (= continuum vacuum) identification is the physically correct one for low-energy observables. The two findings are complementary: (a) lattice-internal running of causal-wave operators with finite N, (b) canonical anchor closures for low-energy physics. The chirality-flip does NOT invalidate any existing MD-36..62 closure; it CLARIFIES that the canonical values are anchor-side identifications of operators whose lattice readings run with N. The 8/144 = 1/18 family-bilinear leakage (a_vac = 15/16 + 1/18) structurally explains the gamma^2/24 1-loop correction to beta_pi observed at iter-31.
